title: AI Task Request
description: A request to execute a task through the framework's workflow and provider runtime.

schema.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

task.description: The task instruction in natural language.

mode.description: The named execution mode (e.g. 'edit', 'review', 'research', 'plan'). Modes gate which capabilities may be allowed.

project_root.description: The resolved, absolute path to the project root this task runs against.

task_type.description: The task classification produced by the workflow's classify stage (e.g. 'implementation', 'review', 'research').

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities this task needs, matching the capability schema. The default is deny unless granted by policy, mode, or approval.

preferred_providers.description: Ordered provider name preferences for this task. Preferences, not direct executable definitions.
